# nhanesGraph

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/minjee-kim/nhanesGraph/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/minjee-kim/nhanesGraph/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

nhanesGraph searches public-use continuous NHANES files and downloads them from the current CDC XPT URLs. It covers 1999-2000 through August 2021-August 2023, including the 2017-2020 pre-pandemic release.

CDC retired the paths used by the 2022 version of this package (and by CRAN RNHANES). Those URLs now return an HTML page, so `nhanes_table()` no longer calls RNHANES.

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("minjee-kim/nhanesGraph")
```

## Load a file

A year or a cycle both work. A short file name is expanded to the cycle-specific CDC name (`EPH` in 2007-2008 becomes `EPH_E`; `DEMO` in 2021-2023 becomes `DEMO_L`).

``` r
library(nhanesGraph)

nhanes_cycles()
nhanes_files()

# 2007-2008 environmental phenols
phenols <- nhanes_table(2008, "EPH", demographics = TRUE)

# August 2021-August 2023 demographics
demo <- nhanes_table("2021-2023", "DEMO")

# 2017-2020 pre-pandemic demographics (also used for years 2019 and 2020)
pre <- nhanes_table(2019, "DEMO")
```

Browse the catalog without downloading:

``` r
nGraph_search()
nGraph_variable()
```

## Plot a variable

``` r
nhanes_viz(graph_type = "hist", file_name = "BPX_D", variable = "BPXSY1")
nhanes_viz("hist", file_name = "DEMO", variable = "RIDAGEYR", year = "2021-2023")
```

`hist` draws a histogram for numeric columns with many values and a bar chart otherwise. `density` is also available.
